finding: A CAPTCHA that appears after the initial SSE gate is released reaches server.js onError and is persisted through generic accountStore.markFailure before captchaResolver is invoked. That gives the account the generic first-failure backoff (~30s) instead of the established account-local CAPTCHA cooldown (10m).

exact_source.server_fact: stream onError currently calls accountStore.markFailure(streamRouteResponse.account, error.message) unconditionally, then checks WAF_CAPTCHA_CHALLENGE only to invoke captchaResolver
exact_source.adapter_fact: parseQwenSSE turns an RGV587_ERROR frame into Error('WAF_CAPTCHA_CHALLENGE:<url>') even after the initial stream gate has already released the response
exact_source.account_store_fact: markCaptchaChallenge owns the explicit 10-minute account-local cooldown; generic markFailure starts at 30 seconds unless the text is RateLimited

required_behavior.late_captcha: classify as account-local CAPTCHA and apply markCaptchaChallenge exactly once before optional resolver handling
required_behavior.provider_circuit: do not turn account-local CAPTCHA into provider-wide stop
required_behavior.thread_affinity: do not change account/chat ownership or replay semantics

related_closed_fact: The earlier secondary chat-id double-classification defect is already closed on current head: sendChatRequest now only continues when generateChatID returns null, and qwen-client-chat-id-classification-test.js is included in npm test.
